output.summary: A perennial evergreen native to central North America, Great Plains yucca forms colonies of narrow-leaved rosettes with drooping white or pale-green flowers. Zuni people traditionally boil its seed pods for food, and young flower stalks and unripe fruits can also be cooked and eaten.
